title: Markdown to EPUB
intro: Convert Markdown into an EPUB3 ebook. Upload a folder (keeps relative paths, so images in the same tree are embedded) or a .zip. Remote images are removed and never fetched; missing local images are reported.
dirHint: Recommended: pick the folder containing the .md and its images.
ignoreImagesHint: When enabled, all images are skipped and only alt text is kept.
importToLibraryHint: On by default: the EPUB is imported into your library as well as generated locally. Turn off to only produce a download.
needFiles: Select a folder or files first
notImported: Not added to the library; an EPUB file was generated.
error.deps.missing: The MyBooks host is missing a required dependency; upgrade the image and try again
error.import.failed: Converted successfully, but adding to the library failed - download the EPUB below to import it manually
error.image.missing: Referenced local image not found: upload a folder / .zip to keep the image tree, or enable "Do not import images"
error.image.unsupported: Unsupported image format (PNG / JPEG / GIF / WEBP / BMP only)
error.image.invalid: Image cannot be parsed or is corrupted
error.image.pil_missing: Server is missing the image component (PIL)
error.image.too_large: A single image exceeds the size limit (20 MB)
error.images.too_large: Total image size exceeds the limit; please trim and retry
error.image.invalid_ref: Invalid image reference (absolute paths are not supported)
error.image.escape: Image reference escapes the upload folder
error.zip.too_many: Too many files inside the zip
error.zip.too_large: Uncompressed zip size exceeds the limit
error.zip.escape: The zip contains an illegal path
